verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs say workflows can run 'on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow' and that transaction monitoring can run 'at scheduled times', so scheduled workflow execution is a documented first-party capability. The evidence is only brief mentions, with no detail on how schedules or recurrence are set up. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cadence or cron-style recurrence), programmatic or API control of schedules, scheduling of arbitrary jobs beyond Portfolio and transaction-monitoring workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
